metadata.purpose: Use latest auxiliary values only at source emission time, gated by all auxiliaries having produced a value.

conditions: An output can occur only on source.next after every auxiliary has produced at least one next.
Auxiliary next updates latest memory but never emits downstream; unready source values are dropped.
Auxiliary completion retains last value and never terminates outer; source complete/error terminates regardless of readiness.

scope.parameters: One to sixteen valid Observable auxiliaries; tuple output without optional result-selector projection.
scope.callbacks: No user callback in this profile. Each output is a fresh array; each member is the unchanged opaque value/reference.
scope.time: No scheduler added; source and auxiliary notifications supply time. Same-time ordering is explicit input order.
scope.reentrancy: Atomic non-reentrant reactions; synchronous callback outcomes are explicit microsteps. Ordered source teardown assumes source setup has returned.
exclusions: Zero auxiliary arguments, whose pinned implementation leaves ready false indefinitely.
Optional resultSelector/projector overload, throwing projector and callback reentrancy.
Synchronous setup-time notifications/errors and ObservableInput conversion from Promise/Iterable.
Unbounded auxiliary counts and arbitrary subscription-side effects.
Throwing observer/producer teardown, arbitrary reentrancy and universal infinite-trace liveness are not modeled.

initialization.sourceSubscription: Subscribe auxiliary inputs in argument order first, then subscribe source; post-setup notifications only.

ownership.sharing: Independent result subscriptions own independent latest memory and auxiliary/source connections; no sharing or replay introduced.
ownership.reset: Create fresh bookkeeping for each result connection. Payload objects are not cloned.

dispatch.actionSemantics: Ordered action words are model predictions, not executed effects. Callback invocation IDs correlate outcomes; they are not subscription IDs.
cancellationCheckpoints: Between external reactions. Cancellation during synchronous multi-action delivery is characterized separately, not silently admitted into this profile.

inputs.description: First connection to this result execution.
A value from the currently owned source subscription.
Source failure with an opaque error value.
Consumer closes the result connection silently.
One auxiliary emits an opaque latest value.
One auxiliary stops without terminating result.
One auxiliary fails and terminates result.

controls.description: See the typed state and named transitions for Active.
Terminated; no owned subscriptions or retained values.

sources.purpose: Upstream scenario basis; test bodies inspected, not claimed to have been executed as the upstream suite.

actions: subscribe to each auxiliary Observable in argument order
rules.nextState: All readiness bits start false; no result is emitted until every auxiliary has a value.
rules.explanation: Auxiliary subscriptions precede source subscription even though only source next can trigger output.

actions: update latest auxiliary value and first-value presence bit, emit nothing
rules.nextState: Readiness changes only when all auxiliaries have emitted at least once.
rules.explanation: Undefined is a valid present value. An auxiliary next never emits an output tuple.

rules.nextState: The last value/presence bit is retained; empty completion can permanently block readiness.
rules.explanation: Auxiliary completion is not output completion. Its last value remains usable on future source next events.

actions: cancel source and other live auxiliaries
rules.nextState: Result terminates; no source value can recover auxiliary failure.
rules.explanation: One auxiliary error ends the result even if readiness was never reached.

rules.guard: at least one auxiliary has not yet produced a value
actions: drop the source value; do not enqueue it for later replay
rules.nextState: Latest ancillary values may still change but there is no source-triggered output.
rules.explanation: When readiness becomes true, earlier source values are lost rather than replayed.

rules.guard: every auxiliary has previously produced at least one value
actions: emit a fresh tuple containing current source value and latest ancillary values
rules.nextState: Auxiliary memory remains unchanged until another auxiliary next.
rules.explanation: The source, not auxiliary emission, determines output timing. Tuple members retain original value identity.

actions: release source and any remaining auxiliaries
rules.nextState: Closed without a final snapshot or synthetic tuple.
rules.explanation: Auxiliary completion is irrelevant to source completion; no pending emissions wait for input readiness.

rules.nextState: Closed without retries or output tuples.
rules.explanation: Errors propagate by identity and are never projected into a value.

actions: release source and all live auxiliaries, emit nothing
rules.nextState: Closed; no retained latest values after teardown.
rules.explanation: Auxiliary subscriptions are owned by each result execution; no implicit share/replay.
